lines.text: Zion will leave the city, camp in open fields, and go to Babylon, where the LORD redeems her.
Many nations assemble against Zion, but they do not know the LORD's plan; He gathers them like sheaves.
The LORD gives Zion horns of iron and hooves of silver to break many peoples to pieces.
A ruler over Israel will come from Bethlehem Ephrathah and shepherd His flock in the strength of the LORD.
Seven shepherds and eight leaders will rule Assyria with the sword, and the land of Midian with the blade drawn.
